item.title: Park City mountaineer Jenn Drummond begins final push to complete seven highest peaks on each continent
item.description: When Drummond completed the Seven Second Summits in 2023, she became the first woman to reach the second-highest peak on every continent. In the two years since, Drummond has focused on returning to each continent in pursuit of the Seven Summits.
